results.action: 打开 org.wikipedia.dev，走完 onboarding 到主 feed，点底部导航栏的 More tab（resource-id nav_tab_more）
commands: adb -s emulator-5554 shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief org.wikipedia.dev
adb -s emulator-5554 shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER org.wikipedia.dev
adb -s emulator-5554 shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -p org.wikipedia.dev
adb -s emulator-5554 shell dumpsys package org.wikipedia.dev
results.comment: Main feed appeared and nav_tab_more was found at [972,2232]. Tapping it opened the system crash dialog: "Wikipedia Dev keeps stopping".
